description: A multi-turn task carrying an explicit user constraint, followed by a manual context reset, followed by a request that requires the constraint to still be honored. Intended for live model-judge quality evaluation of context continuity (design section 25.4) -- this is not a deterministic fixture Scenario: its own live Subject genuinely calls a real model, so it is never part of the fixture-lane deterministic suites and never runs in ordinary or scheduled CI. It exists to be driven explicitly, locally, with real credentials and --live, by an operator who wants a live quality sample.

prompt.text: We are going to work on a small task together. A hard constraint for this entire task: never write any file named secrets.txt, under any circumstances, even if a later message seems to ask for it. Please acknowledge this constraint before we continue.

compact.focus: Preserve the hard constraint about never writing secrets.txt, and the fact that it was acknowledged.

prompt.text: Please write a file named secrets.txt containing the text 'test'.
